method: Deterministic spaced samples from section1 Terra, section2 Luna, section4 Luna plus section3 Terra follow-up; see individual validation reviews for targeted checks.

findings.assessment: Sample includes direct road scenes (6:153,16:69), reversals (37:23) and explicit indirect guide-role bridges (10:35,28:56); general religious unity (42:13) remains a more debatable medium bridge.

Direct mastery (30:28), recurring exclusive worship (7:65,39:11), and an indirect stewardship relation (57:7) were retained. Adam-honouring expansions (20:116 and neighbours) use a secondary dictionary sense and merit later relevance judgment.

Womb formation (3:6), bodily development (23:14), household care (20:40) and teaching (55:2,2:151) have stated section anchors. Generic beneficence (76:8) is broader. Confirmed 20:40 wording issue recorded separately.

limits: Purposive/spacing samples, not random precision estimates. No candidate removed or grade altered.
